tasks.name: Installing Smoke Detectors
goal_conditions: fire alarm 1 is attached to wall nail 1
execution_guidance: Please see how the orientations of parts should be from the [visualizations on this link](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1NUvmnwBtM4zz6tN17PEUBG1eTIFGlYGU).

Use the attachment visualization to locate the wall nail target. For grasping first you should rotate the smoke detector such that the blue line should be orthogonal to the gripper (pointing verticaly to the grippers) and then bring the smoke detector close to that marker before trying to attach it.
Align the detector with the visualized attachment lines (blue,red,green) on the nail. Avoid pressing hard into the wall or scraping the detector along the surface.

Detector will snap onto the nail when the error between the lines are lower then some threshold. After it snaps, release the gripper carefully and confirm it stays fixed to the wall nail before ending the demo.
tasks.instruction: Satisfy all of these final conditions: fire alarm 1 is attached to wall nail 1.

tasks.name: Carrying Out Garden Furniture
goal_conditions: lawn chair 1 is on top of floor 2
At least one lawn must satisfy: barrow 1 is on top of lawn
execution_guidance: Note that the long lawn chair was resampled into a small chair which is different from the demo video. Both chairs are now the same so they can be carried in either order.
Also different from the demo video, open the door slightly first and then push it from the other side to avoid wobble, instead of opening it all the way while grasping it.
Carry the wheelbarrow out by grasping the handles close to the barrow, then moving the robot up so the wheel is in contact with the ground.
You can carry the chair and barrow out in either order, it is preferred to carry out whatever is closest to the door at start.
Lift up the chair when carrying so it does not touch the ground during robot movement, which might cause the robot to wobble.
The chair should be facing the pool.

In this task, it is fine and expected to have some ghost (red) arms while carrying the chairs or wheelbarrow because it is heavy. Just try to minimize the ghost arm discrepancy when setting the furniture down, right before letting go, to minimize jerky behavior.
It is fine to use fast movement mode, but do not use it when crossing the door, as that would cause robot to wobble a lot.
Pushing the lawn chair or barrow before grasping is allowed (e.g. to make way for opening the door, for easier grasp, etc.)
In general, small robot wobbling is allowed in this task.
tasks.instruction: Satisfy all of these final conditions: lawn chair 1 is on top of floor 2; At least one lawn must satisfy: barrow 1 is on top of lawn.

tasks.name: Make Gift Bags For Baby Showers
goal_conditions: Every sack must satisfy: sack is on top of coffee table 1
Pair the toy dice objects one-to-one with the sack objects so each paired toy dice satisfies: toy dice is inside sack
Pair the wafer objects one-to-one with the sack objects so each paired wafer satisfies: wafer is inside sack
execution_guidance: The wafers will always spawn inside one of the two upper cabinet drawers due to reachability constraints.
Open the cabinet drawer with the right gripper. When opening the drawer, move the base backward rather than pulling primarily with the arm.
To grasp a wafer:
Align the robot with the wafer’s vertical orientation.
Raise the torso as high as possible.
Approach the wafer from above with a top-down gripper orientation.
Lower the torso until the wafer is reachable, then grasp it.
After grasping the wafer, close the cabinet drawer with the left gripper.
Grasp a toy dice with the left gripper.
Navigate to a paper bag and place both the wafer and toy dice inside.
Repeat the process for the second wafer, toy dice, and paper bag.
Even if both wafers spawn in the same drawer, maintain the following sequence:
Grasp the first wafer.
Grasp the first toy dice.
Create the first gift bag.
Grasp the second wafer.
Grasp the second toy dice.
Create the second gift bag.
After both gift bags have been created, grasp one gift bag with each gripper.
When grasping a paper bag, make sure to grasp only the bag itself. In the demo, the gripper touches the wafer when grasping the bag; do not do this, as it will be reported as a failed grasp.
Navigate to the coffee table and place both gift bags on it.
tasks.instruction: Satisfy all of these final conditions: Every sack must satisfy: sack is on top of coffee table 1; Pair the toy dice objects one-to-one with the sack objects so each paired toy dice satisfies: toy dice is inside sack; Pair the wafer objects one-to-one with the sack objects so each paired wafer satisfies: wafer is inside sack.

tasks.name: Sorting Books On Shelf
goal_conditions: Every comic book must satisfy: comic book is inside bookcase 1
Exactly 2 comic book object(s) must satisfy: comic book is on top of comic book 1; or comic book is on top of comic book 2; or comic book is on top of comic book 3
Every notebook must satisfy: notebook is inside bookcase 1
At least one notebook must satisfy: notebook is on top of notebook 1; or notebook is on top of notebook 2
Every hardback must satisfy: hardback is inside bookcase 1
At least one hardback must satisfy: hardback is on top of hardback 1; or hardback is on top of hardback 2
execution_guidance: Hardback books are the thick mint and blue books with simple graphics on the cover.
Notebooks are the blue and gray spiral-bound items.
Comic books are the ones with illustrations and Japanese text.
The books are initially arranged across four shelf compartments as follows:
`hardback_1`
`notebook_2` stacked on top of `comic_book_1`
`comic_book_2` stacked on top of `notebook_1`
`hardback_2` stacked on top of `comic_book_3`
Navigate to the shelf and position the robot so that `hardback_2` (the thick mint-colored book) can be reached comfortably.
Grasp `hardback_2` with the right gripper and place it on top of `hardback_1` (the thick blue-colored book).
Pick up `notebook_2` (blue notebook with spring) and `comic_book_2`, using either gripper for each object as convenient.
Place `notebook_2` on top of `notebook_1` (grey notebook with spring).
Place `comic_book_2` on top of `comic_book_3`.
Grasp `comic_book_1` with the right gripper and place it on top of `comic_book_2`.
tasks.instruction: Satisfy all of these final conditions: Every comic book must satisfy: comic book is inside bookcase 1; Exactly 2 comic book object(s) must satisfy: comic book is on top of comic book 1; or comic book is on top of comic book 2; or comic book is on top of comic book 3; Every notebook must satisfy: notebook is inside bookcase 1; At least one notebook must satisfy: notebook is on top of notebook 1; or notebook is on top of notebook 2; Every hardback must satisfy: hardback is inside bookcase 1; At least one hardback must satisfy: hardback is on top of hardback 1; or hardback is on top of hardback 2.
